content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates are advised to complete the application process by 6:00 PM on the last date, as technical support may not be available after that time, though the portal remains open until 11:59 PM.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies is indicative and the Company may increase, decrease, or draw a panel for future/drop-out vacancies. Locations are also indicative, and selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad based on business requirements. No candidate above 58 years of age shall be engaged, regardless of category relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Preferred qualifications and preferred experience (e.g. specific specializations, certifications like Ethical Hacking, or MBA in Finance) are detailed separately for each post in the official notification and may improve shortlisting chances but are not mandatory minimums.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age varies by post (see the Vacancy table above - 30, 32, 35, or 38 years), reckoned as on the cut-off date of 29/09/2026. Age relaxation is available as below. Only persons with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for PwBD relaxation, subject to a valid disability certificate. No candidate above 58 years of age will be engaged under any category. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged on a 3-year Fixed Term Contract, with compensation linked to qualification and experience as per industry standards.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify any application fee for any category. Candidates should check the official website for any updates on this before applying.

content_sections.heading: Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not lay out a fixed multi-stage selection process. Only candidates found prima facie eligible based on the application form will be called for further stages. The Company reserves the right to decide the mode of engagement - Interview, Written Test, Group Discussion, or a combination of these - along with the venue and schedule, depending on the number of vacancies and applications received.

content_sections.text: Register on the Balmer Lawrie e-recruitment portal using the candidate registration link on balmerlawrie.com/careers/current-openings After creating your profile, go to the "Employment Opportunities" tab and apply against the appropriate position Note that creating a profile alone does not ensure consideration of your candidature - you must formally apply for a specific post Provide a correct and updated email ID and mobile number, as interview intimation (if shortlisted) will be sent only via email Complete and submit the application online between 9 September 2026 (10:00 AM) and 29 September 2026 (11:59 PM) For any application-related difficulty, use the "Feedback" link on the website

faq.question: Q1. What is Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement Ref. No. BL/HR/CHR/RECT/RECFT/202627/0003 issued by Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. for 38 posts across 27 positions on a 3-year Fixed Term Contract.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 38 total vacancies across positions ranging from Unit Head to Junior Officer, spread across various SBUs and locations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post - from full-time graduate/engineering degrees to MBA, Company Secretary, or Commerce degrees. See the Eligibility table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Maximum age varies by post (30, 32, 35, or 38 years) as on 29 September 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply through the Balmer Lawrie e-recruitment portal at balmerlawrie.com/careers/current-openings between 9 and 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Company will shortlist eligible candidates and may conduct an Interview, Written Test, and/or Group Discussion at its discretion; the exact process is not detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary varies by post and location, ranging from a maximum take-home of ₹36,977/month (Junior Officer level) to ₹1,11,980/month (Unit Head), with CTC ranging from ₹5.58 lakh to ₹16.21 lakh per annum.
